figurative_meaning_en: The clamor in the middle of the market; shouting of a large crowd
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে হঠাৎ একটা হট্টগোল শুরু হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Suddenly a commotion started in the market.
Why is there so much uproar in the neighborhood?
note: This idiom evokes the lively, noisy atmosphere of traditional Bengali rural markets (haats).
